name: @jiscribe/cli
description: Command-line checking, measuring, diagnosing, drawing and editing of jiscribe documents, and their drawing guides

comments.dependencies: Everything but fontkit and @jiscribe/doc-schema is bundled into dist/index.mjs. Two kinds of file are resolved by path at run time rather than imported, from dist/ upwards: the @fontsource packages hold the font files the Node measurer reads (see @jiscribe/doc-tools), and @jiscribe/doc-schema holds the two guides `jiscribe guide` prints (see @jiscribe/doc-tools/guides). Drop one and the bundle still builds, then fails on first use.
comments.devDependencies: The canvas, the standard shape set, react and katex are the ingredients of the two browser pages: the render harness (harness/ -> dist/harness) and the preview page (preview/ -> dist/preview). Nothing under src/ imports them: the CLI itself stays headless, and takes the shape set it edits with from @jiscribe/doc-tools/canvas-tools.
